title: Marilyn Monroe Action Hero
description: A dramatic painted collage featuring multiple depictions of a blonde woman resembling Marilyn Monroe in a blue jumpsuit with red scarf and heels. The largest close-up portrait at the bottom shows her with a bruised eye and red lips, while three dynamic action poses above show her running, holding a gun, and casting a magical spark, set against an explosive nighttime harbor scene with fire, a boat, and floating playing cards.
prompt: A dramatic collage of multiple action poses of a blonde woman styled like Marilyn Monroe wearing a tight blue jumpsuit, red neck scarf, and red high heels. She has curly platinum hair and red lipstick. One large close-up portrait at bottom shows her face with a bruised black eye. Other poses show her running, holding a pistol, and casting a green magical spark from her hand. Background is a chaotic nighttime harbor with a burning boat, massive orange explosions, flying debris, and scattered playing cards under dramatic spotlights.
